title: Naidu, Sitharaman launch Rayalaseema horticulture hub; Anant Ambani pledges ₹1 lakh crore for biogas in Andhra
description: The Chief Minister promises irrigation, processing and export support to make the drought-prone region a ‘global fruit bowl’; Reliance, which will run the new Indian School of Agriculture, announces ₹1 lakh crore for biogas plants
